candidats.description: Vue détaillée d’un ancien bâtiment résidentiel en ruine de la cité-jardin historique de Rerik , dans le quartier de Rerik-West , sur la péninsule de Wustrow , en Mecklembourg-Poméranie-Occidentale, en Allemagne. On distingue une fenêtre en bois altérée par les intempéries, aux vitres brisées, un enduit écaillé laissant apparaître la maçonnerie, un vestige de balcon délabré ainsi qu’un rosier rugueux ( Rosa rugosa ) portant des cynorrhodons rouges. candidats.titre: File:Liverpool window view - Royal Liver Building & Port of Liverpool Building (10628920405).jpg
candidats.description: View from the window at the International Slavery Museum, Albert Dock, Liverpool. The Liverpool Waterfront. It has changed so much since the days of the transatlantic slave trade ended. The three famous 20th century Pier Head buildings stand on the site of George's Dock where slave ships bound for Africa loaded their goods. The two dry docks, in front of the Great Western Railway building, were built in the 18th century, Slave ships were repaired in these docks. They are a vivid reminder of the horrors of Liverpool's slave trading, and monuments to the commercial success of 18th century Liverp

candidats.description: The Farolim de Felgueiras is a Portuguese lighthouse located at the tip of the jetty of the same name, in the parish of Foz do Douro , Oporto City . This is a tower hexagonal in masonry of granite apparent, with ten meters high. It has a red balcony and lantern, and a small annex building with plastered walls painted in white. The designation 'Molhe de Felgueiras' was attributed to it because it was built towards the Felgueiras rock, which is bordered by the West. Before deactivating, the light had a range of 9 nautical miles , emitting red lightning every 5 seconds. Porto Portugal.
